The Grassroots

Guided product tour

Open the live app

Every function, clicked through on the real screens.

The Grassroots is a results-based monitoring and evaluation platform. It tracks development projects from field activity up to national plans, and it calculates status from data instead of asking anyone to self-report. Click the highlighted spot on each screen, or press Play for a narrated run in which a woman and a man take turns.

How it works

Arrow keys move between steps. The highlighted spot performs the click.

Why this platform matters

The Grassroots holds monitoring and evaluation in one place, from a single field activity up to a national plan, in language a manager, a donor, and a field officer all read the same way.

Status comes from data

Nobody picks a project’s colour. The platform derives status from the baseline, the target, the latest measurement, and the time elapsed.

One results chain

Every activity feeds an output, every output an outcome, every outcome an impact inside the plan, so results add up with no extra effort.

Evidence and ready reports

Evidence is attached to each result, and project, evaluation, and monthly reports export to PDF in one click.

Arabic and on the phone

A complete right-to-left Arabic interface, and a phone app that works offline on the same figures.

Try the status engine

Enter values and watch how the platform settles on a status. Performance is progress divided by the share of time elapsed.

progress    = (value - baseline) / (target - baseline)
performance = progress / time elapsed

Six status tiers

A KPI with no report yet counts as 0%, so silence never looks like success.

Over Trackabove 100%
On Track90 to 100%
At Risk75 to 90%
Off Track50 to 75%
Under Track0 to 50%
Back Trackbelow baseline

Voice settings

The tour alternates between a woman’s voice and a man’s voice at each step. Natural English voices such as Aria, Guy, Emma and Andrew are available in Microsoft Edge. Chrome offers the Google US English voice.
